title: The web app copes when the Link clock drops, is noisy, is suspended, or isn't offered
description:
As a performer using the web app, I want the page to cope when the clock goes away or can't be offered, so that a hiccup never stops the music or leaves me guessing.

Spec file: `features/link/browser.feature`.

```gherkin
Feature: Losing and finding the Link clock in the web app

  Scenario: The server goes away
    Given the web app plays in a Link session
    When the connection to "/link" drops
    Then the web app keeps playing at the last tempo on its own clock
    And the app shows that Link is lost and it is retrying
    When the connection comes back
    Then playback re-aligns on the session's next bar line

  Scenario: A slow round trip is not trusted
    Given the clock offset was measured from pings with 2 ms round trips
    When a ping comes back after 80 ms
    Then that ping does not move the clock offset

  Scenario: The tab was in the background
    Given the web app plays in a Link session
    When the tab comes back after its audio was suspended
    Then playback re-aligns on the session's next bar line

  Scenario: The cloud app offers no Link
    Given the web app was opened from the cloud (amplify_outputs.json has no custom.apricity.link)
    Then there is no Link control
    And the Docs say how to use Link with apricity serve --link
```
